docstring: The status from the CoinbaseProOrder object converted to xchange status
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION adaptOrderStatus(order)
    IF order.status equals "pending" THEN
        RETURN PENDING_NEW
    END IF
    
    IF order.status equals "done" OR order.status equals "settled" THEN
    
        IF order.done_reason equals "filled" THEN
            RETURN FILLED
        END IF
        
        IF order.done_reason equals "canceled" THEN
            RETURN CANCELED
        END IF
        
        RETURN UNKNOWN
    END IF
    
    IF order.filled_size has signum 0 THEN
    
        IF order.status equals "open" AND order.stop has value THEN
            // This is a massive edge case of a stop triggering but not immediately
            // fulfilling.  STOPPED status is only currently used by the HitBTC and
            // YoBit implementations and in both cases it looks like a
            // misunderstanding and those should return CANCELLED.  Should we just
            // remove this status?
            RETURN STOPPED
        END IF
        
        RETURN NEW
    END IF
    
    IF order.filled_size is greater than or equal to 0
        // if size >= filledSize order should be partially filled
        AND order.size is greater than or equal to order.filled_size THEN
        RETURN PARTIALLY_FILLED
    END IF
    
    RETURN UNKNOWN
END FUNCTION

docstring:
Given a set of m probabilities, draw with replacement a set of n random
number in [0, m).
@param prob probabilities of size n. The prob argument can be used to
give a vector of weights for obtaining the elements of the vector being
sampled. They need not sum to one, but they should be nonnegative and
not all zero.
@return an random array of length n in range of [0, m).
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION random(prob, n)
    SETUP ALIAS TABLE
    SETUP HEAD AND TAIL POINTERS
    WHILE HEAD IS NOT EQUAL TO ZERO AND TAIL IS NOT EQUAL TO LENGTH OF PROB
        SET J EQUAL TO NEXT VALUE IN TAIL POINTERS
        SET K EQUAL TO PREVIOUS VALUE IN HEAD POINTERS
        SET A[J] EQUAL TO K
        SET Q[K] EQUAL TO Q[K] PLUS Q[J] MINUS ONE
        DECREMENT TAIL POINTER
        IF Q[K] IS GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO ONE THEN
            ADD K TO TAIL POINTERS
            DECREMENT HEAD POINTER
        END IF
    END WHILE
    SET ANSWER ARRAY EQUAL TO NEW INT ARRAY WITH SIZE N
    FOR I FROM 0 TO N MINUS ONE
        SET RU EQUAL TO CALL RANDOM METHOD MULTIPLIED BY PROB LENGTH
        SET K EQUAL TO INT PART OF RU
        SET RU EQUAL TO RU MINUS K
        IF RU IS LESS THAN Q[K] THEN
            SET ANSWER[I] EQUAL TO K
        ELSE
            SET ANSWER[I] EQUAL TO A[K]
        END IF
    END FOR
    RETURN ANSWER ARRAY
END FUNCTION

import random

def random_with_replacement(prob, n):
    alias_table = {}
    head_pointer = 0
    tail_pointer = 0

    while head_pointer != 0 and tail_pointer != len(prob):
        j = tail_pointer
        k = head_pointer
        alias_table[j] = k
        q[k] += q[j] - 1
        tail_pointer -= 1
        if q[k] >= 1:
            tail_pointer += 1
            head_pointer -= 1

    answer = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        ru = random.random() * len(prob)
        k = int(ru)
        ru -= k
        if ru < q[k]:
            answer[i] = k
        else:
            answer[i] = alias_table[k]

    return answer

docstring:
Each message will be written to one or more outputs.

The default output is always being used for every message, but optionally the message can be routed to additional outputs, currently based on the stream outputs that are configured in the system.

The stream outputs are time limited so one bad output does not impact throughput too much. Essentially this means that the work of writing to the outputs is performed, but the writer threads will not wait forever for stream outputs to finish their work. This might lead to increased memory usage!

The default output, however, is allowed to block and is not subject to time limiting. This is important because it can exert back pressure on the processing pipeline this way, making sure we don't run into excessive heap usage.

@param event the message to write to outputs @throws Exception
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION onEvent(event)
    INCREMENT incomingMessages
    SET message = event.getMessage()
    IF message IS NULL THEN
        PRINT "Skipping null message."
        RETURN
    END IF
    PRINT "Processing message <{}> from OutputBuffer.".format(message.getId())

    SET messageOutputs = getStreamOutputsForMessage(message)
    MARK messageOutputs
    MESSAGE_OUTPUTS_SIZE = SIZE OF messageOutputs
    PRINT "Processing message <{}>. Matched {} outputs.".format(message.getId(), MESSAGE_OUTPUTS_SIZE)

    SET defaultOutputCompletion = PROCESS_MESSAGE(message, DEFAULT_MESSAGE_OUTPUT)

    SET streamOutputsDoneSignal = NEW COUNTDOWNLATCH(MESSAGE_OUTPUTS_SIZE)
    FOR EACH OUTPUT IN messageOutputs DO
        PROCESS_MESSAGE(message, OUTPUT, streamOutputsDoneSignal)
    END FOR

    WAIT_UNTIL streamOutputsDoneSignal.await(configuration.getOutputModuleTimeout(), MILLISECONDS) OR TIMEOUT IS REACHED
    IF defaultOutputCompletion IS NOT NULL THEN
        UNINTERRUPTIBLY WAIT FOR defaultOutputCompletion
    ELSE
        PRINT "The default output future was null, this is a bug!"
    END IF

    IF message.hasRecordings() THEN
        PRINT "Message event trace: {}".format(message.recordingsAsString())
    END IF

    INCREMENT outputThroughput
    PRINT "Wrote message <{}> to all outputs. Finished handling.".format(message.getId())
    CLEAR event.messages()
END FUNCTION

PROCESS_MESSAGE(message, output, streamOutputsDoneSignal)
    PRINT "Processing message <{}> to output <{}>.".format(message.getId(), output.getId())
    SET completion = output.write(message)
    IF completion IS NOT NULL THEN
        ADD_LISTENER TO completion, streamOutputsDoneSignal
    END IF
END FUNCTION

def on_event(self, event: Event) -> None:
    self.incoming_messages += 1
    message = event.get_message()
    if message is None:
        print("Skipping null message.")
        return
    print(f"Processing message {message.id} from OutputBuffer.")

    message_outputs = self.get_stream_outputs_for_message(message)
    message_outputs.mark()
    message_outputs_size = len(message_outputs)
    print(f"Processing message {message.id}. Matched {message_outputs_size} outputs.")

    default_output_completion = self.process_message(message, self.default_message_output)

    stream_outputs_done_signal = CountDownLatch(message_outputs_size)
    for output in message_outputs:
        self.process_message(message, output, stream_outputs_done_signal)
    stream_outputs_done_signal.await(self.configuration.output_module_timeout, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)

    if default_output_completion is not None:
        default_output_completion.uninterruptibly_wait()
    else:
        print("The default output future was null, this is a bug!")

    if message.has_recordings():
        print(f"Message event trace: {message.recordings_as_string()}")

    self.output_throughput += 1
    print(f"Wrote message {message.id} to all outputs. Finished handling.")
    event.clear()

def on_event(self, event: Event) -> None:
    self.incoming_messages += 1
    message = event.get_message()
    if message is None:
        print("Skipping null message.")
        return
    print(f"Processing message {message.id} from OutputBuffer.")

    message_outputs = self.get_stream_outputs_for_message(message)
    message_outputs.mark()
    message_outputs_size = len(message_outputs)
    print(f"Processing message {message.id}. Matched {message_outputs_size} outputs.")

    default_output_completion = self.process_message(message, self.default_message_output)

    stream_outputs_done_signal = CountDownLatch(message_outputs_size)
    for output in message_outputs:
        self.process_message(message, output, stream_outputs_done_signal)
    stream_outputs_done_signal.await(self.configuration.output_module_timeout, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)

    if default_output_completion is not None:
        default_output_completion.uninterruptibly_wait()
    else:
        print("The default output future was null, this is a bug!")

    if message.has_recordings():
        print(f"Message event trace: {message.recordings_as_string()}")

    self.output_throughput += 1
    print(f"Wrote message {message.id} to all outputs. Finished handling.")
    event.clear()

FUNCTION copyWriterCount(in,out)
    DECLARE tot as Integer
    DECLARE buffer as Array of Characters of Size 10240
    SET tot to 0
    SET c to in.read(buffer)
    WHILE c is greater than or equal to zero DO
        IF c is greater than zero THEN
            out.write(buffer, 0, c)
            increment tot by c
        END IF
        SET c to in.read(buffer)
    END WHILE
    RETURN tot
END FUNCTION

    ELSIF (mergePolicyInstance is instanceof com.hazelcast.replicatedmap.merge.StringMergePolicy) THEN

        IF (!stringMergePolicy.isCompatible(replicatedMapConfig)) THEN

    ELSIF (mergePolicyInstance is instanceof com.hazelcast.replicatedmap.merge.ListMergePolicy) THEN

    ELSIF (mergePolicyInstance is instanceof com.hazelcast.replicatedmap.merge.SetMergePolicy) THEN

cached map of cookies.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION getCachedCookies()
    IF STATE is equal to NOT_READ THEN
        SET STATE to READING
    ELSE
        FOR infinite LOOP
            IF STATE is equal to READ THEN
                RETURN cachedCookies
            END IF
        END LOOP
    END IF

    SET allCookieHeaders to nettyHeaders.getAll(cookiesHeaderName)
    SET cookies to an empty map
    FOR each element in allCookieHeaders DO
        IF isClientChannel THEN
            SET c to ((ClientCookieDecoder) decoder).decode(aCookieHeader)
            SET existingCookiesOfName to cookies.get(c.name())
            IF existingCookiesOfName is NULL THEN
                SET existingCookiesOfName to a set of elements
                SET cookies[c.name()] to existingCookiesOfName
            END IF

            SET existingCookiesOfName to cookies[c.name()]
            ADD c to existingCookiesOfName
        ELSE
            SET decode to ((ServerCookieDecoder) decoder).decode(aCookieHeader)
            FOR each element in decode DO
                SET cookie to element

                SET existingCookiesOfName to cookies.get(cookie.name())
                IF existingCookiesOfName is NULL THEN
                    SET existingCookiesOfName to a set of elements
                    SET cookies[cookie.name()] to existingCookiesOfName
                END IF

                SET existingCookiesOfName to cookies[cookie.name()]
                ADD cookie to existingCookiesOfName
            END FOR
        END IF
    END FOR

    SET cachedCookies to unmodifiableMap(cookies)
    SET STATE to READ
    RETURN cachedCookies
END FUNCTION

import time
import netty_headers

STATE = NOT_READ
cached_cookies = None
cookies_header_name = "cookies"

def get_cached_cookies():
    global STATE, cached_cookies

    # Check if the cookies have been cached
    if STATE == NOT_READ:
        STATE = READING

    while True:
        if STATE == READ:
            return cached_cookies

        # Wait for the cookies to become available
        time.sleep(1)

    # Cache the cookies
    all_cookie_headers = netty_headers.get_all(cookies_header_name)
    cookies = {}
    for cookie_header in all_cookie_headers:
        if is_client_channel:
            cookie = ClientCookieDecoder(decoder).decode(cookie_header)
            existing_cookies_of_name = cookies.get(cookie.name())
            if existing_cookies_of_name is None:
                existing_cookies_of_name = set()
                cookies[cookie.name()] = existing_cookies_of_name

            existing_cookies_of_name.add(cookie)
        else:
            decode = ServerCookieDecoder(decoder).decode(cookie_header)
            for cookie in decode:
                existing_cookies_of_name = cookies.get(cookie.name())
                if existing_cookies_of_name is None:
                    existing_cookies_of_name = set()
                    cookies[cookie.name()] = existing_cookies_of_name

                existing_cookies_of_name.add(cookie)

    cached_cookies = unmodifiable_map(cookies)
    STATE = READ
    return cached_cookies

FUNCTION echoFrame(channel, ws)
    DECLARE type
    DECLARE sink

    SET type TO ws.getType()
    IF type EQUALS PONG THEN
        CLOSE ws
    ELSIF type EQUALS PING THEN
        SET type TO PONG
    ENDIF

    SET sink TO channel.send(type)
    SET sink.rsv TO ws.rsv
    CALL initiateTransfer(ws, sink, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, channel.bufferPool)

    FUNCTION initiateTransfer(ws, sink, ws_listener, sink_listener, ws_exception_handler, sink_exception_handler, buffer_pool)
        DECLARE transfer_complete

        CALL sink.shutdownWrites()

        CALL sink.flush()

        CALL sink.getWriteSetter().set(NULL)

        CALL safeClose(sink)

        CALL sink.getWriteSetter().set(NULL)

        CALL safeClose(sink)

        IF type EQUALS CLOSE THEN
            CALL safeClose(channel)
        ENDIF
    END FUNCTION

    FUNCTION safeClose(channel)
        CALL safeClose(channel, channel)
    END FUNCTION
END FUNCTION

import re

def is_valid_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """
    Validates name of Kubernetes Resource name, label or annotation based on Kubernetes regex
    """
    # Check if name is not null
    if not name:
        return False

    # Check if name length is less than KUBERNETES_DNS1123_LABEL_MAX_LENGTH
    if len(name) > 112:
        return False

    # Check if name matches KUBERNETES_DNS1123_LABEL_REGEX
    regex = re.compile(r'^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$')
    return regex.match(name) is not None

FUNCTION formalTypeParametersString(type)
    LIST typeParameters = type.getTypeParameters()
    IF typeParameters is empty THEN
        RETURN ""
    ELSE
        STRING builder = "<"
        STRING separator = ""
        FOR typeParameter IN typeParameters DO
            builder.append(separator)
            separator = ", "
            appendTypeParameterWithBounds(typeParameter, builder)
        END FOR
        RETURN builder.append(">")
    END IF

FUNCTION toBeanProperty(base, property)
    BEANPROPERTIES beanproperties = cache.get(base.class)
    IF beanproperties equals NULL THEN
        BEANPROPERTIES newbeanproperties = new BeanProperties(base.class)
        beanproperties = cache.putIfAbsent(base.class, newbeanproperties)
        IF beanproperties equals NULL THEN
            beanproperties = newbeanproperties
        END IF
    END IF
    BEANPROPERTY beanproperty = property equals NULL ? NULL : beanproperties.getBeanProperty(property.toString())
    IF beanproperty equals NULL THEN
        THROW PropertyNotFoundException("Could not find property " + property + " in " + base.class)
    END IF
    RETURN beanproperty
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION copyFile(executionContext, file, input, content, node, remotePath)
    DECLARE workingDir as File
    DECLARE scriptArgs as String
    DECLARE dirString as String

    //get project or framework property for script-exec args
    DECLARE framework as Framework
    DECLARE project as Project
    //look for specific property
    scriptArgs = framework.getProjectProperty(project, SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_COMMAND_PROPERTY)


    IF null != node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE) THEN
        scriptArgs = node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF
    IF null == scriptArgs THEN
        THROW FileCopierException(
            "[script-copy file copier] no attribute " + SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE + " was found on node: "
            + node
                .getNodename() + ", and no " + SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_COMMAND_PROPERTY
            + " property was configured for the project or framework."
        )
    ENDIF

    dirString = framework.getProjectProperty(project, SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_DIR_PROPERTY)
    IF null != node.getAttributes().get(DIR_ATTRIBUTE) THEN
        dirString = node.getAttributes().get(DIR_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF
    IF null != dirString AND NOT "".equals(dirString) THEN
        workingDir = new File(dirString)
    ENDIF

    DECLARE srcFile as File
    IF null != file THEN
        srcFile = file
    ELSE
        srcFile = BaseFileCopier.writeTempFile(executionContext, file, input, content)
    ENDIF


    //create context data with node attributes
    DECLARE nodeContext as Map<String, Map<String, String>>
    nodeContext = DataContextUtils.addContext("node", DataContextUtils.nodeData(node), executionContext.getDataContext())

    DECLARE scptExec as Map<String, String>
    scptExec = {}
    //set filename of source file
    scptExec["filename"] = srcFile.getName()
    scptExec["destfilename"] = srcFile.getName()
    scptExec["file"] = srcFile.getAbsolutePath()
    //add file, dir, destination to the file-copy data
    IF null != node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE) THEN
        scptExec["file"] = node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF
    IF null != workingDir THEN
        //set up the data context to include the working dir
        scptExec["dir"] = workingDir.getAbsolutePath()
    ENDIF

    DECLARE newDataContext as Map<String, Map<String, String>>
    newDataContext = DataContextUtils.addContext("file-copy", scptExec, nodeContext)

    DECLARE copiedFilePath as String
    //expand remote filepath if we are copying a script
    IF null == remotePath THEN
        copiedFilePath = framework.getProjectProperty(project,
                                                      SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_REMOTE_FILEPATH_PROPERTY)
        IF null != node.getAttributes().get(REMOTE_FILEPATH_ATTRIBUTE) THEN
            copiedFilePath = node.getAttributes().get(REMOTE_FILEPATH_ATTRIBUTE)
        ENDIF
        IF null != copiedFilePath THEN
            IF NOT (copiedFilePath.contains("${file-copy.filename}") OR copiedFilePath.contains("${file-copy.file}")) AND NOT copiedFilePath.endsWith("/") THEN
                copiedFilePath += "/"
            ENDIF
            copiedFilePath = DataContextUtils.replaceDataReferencesInString(copiedFilePath, newDataContext)
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        //we are copying to a specific destination
        copiedFilePath = remotePath
    ENDIF

    //put file in a directory
    IF null != copiedFilePath AND copiedFilePath.endsWith("/") THEN
        copiedFilePath += srcFile.getName()
    ENDIF

    scptExec["destination"] = null != copiedFilePath ? copiedFilePath : ""

    newDataContext = DataContextUtils.addContext("file-copy", scptExec, nodeContext)

    DECLARE exec as Process
    DECLARE remoteShell as String
    remoteShell = framework.getProjectProperty(project, SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_REMOTE_SHELL)
    IF null != node.getAttributes().get(SHELL_ATTRIBUTE) THEN
        remoteShell = node.getAttributes().get(SHELL_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF

    IF null != remoteShell THEN
        exec = ScriptUtil.execShellProcess(executionContext.getExecutionListener(), workingDir, scriptArgs,
                                           nodeContext, newDataContext, remoteShell, "script-copy")
    ELSE
        exec = ScriptUtil.execProcess(executionContext.getExecutionListener(), workingDir, scriptArgs,
                                      nodeContext,
                                      newDataContext, "script-copy")
    ENDIF
    exec.getOutputStream().close()

        exec.getErrorStream().close()

Returns the number of microseconds since the epoch (00:00:00, 01-Jan-1970, GMT). The precision of the
returned value may vary depending on {@linkplain #javaVersion() Java version}. Currently, Java 9 or
above is required for microsecond precision. {@code System.currentTimeMillis() * 1000} is returned on
Java 8.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION currentTimeMicros()
    IF javaVersion() equals 8 THEN
        RETURN TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toMicros(System.currentTimeMillis())
    ELSE
        // Java 9+ support higher precision wall time.
        DECLARE instant now
        SET now = Clock.systemUTC().instant()
        RETURN TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMicros(now.getEpochSecond()) + TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMicros(
                now.getNano())
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION clean(dirtyDocument)
    create clean
    IF dirtyDocument.body() is not NULL then
        copySafeNodes(dirtyDocument.body(), clean.body())
    END IF

    RETURN clean
END FUNCTION

function copySafeNodes(nodeList, destination)
    FOR node IN nodeList DO
        IF isSafeNode(node) then
            appendNode(destination, cloneNode(node))
        END IF
    END FOR
END FUNCTION

function isSafeNode(node)
    IF node is ELEMENT then
        RETURN node.tagName() is in WHITELIST
    ELSIF node is TEXT then
        RETURN TRUE
    END IF
END FUNCTION

function cloneNode(node)
    IF node is ELEMENT then
        RETURN ELEMENT(node.namespaceURI(), node.localName(), node.attributes())
    ELSIF node is TEXT then
        RETURN TEXT(node.data())
    END IF
END FUNCTION

function appendNode(parent, child)
    parent.appendChild(child)
END FUNCTION

            conn.disconnect()
        END IF
    END TRY
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION checkTouchSlop(directions, pointerId)
    IF isPointerDown(pointerId) THEN
        checkHorizontal = directions AND DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL EQUALS DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL
        checkVertical = directions AND DIRECTION_VERTICAL EQUALS DIRECTION_VERTICAL
        
        dx = mLastMotionX[pointerId] - mInitialMotionX[pointerId]
        dy = mLastMotionY[pointerId] - mInitialMotionY[pointerId]
        
        IF checkHorizontal AND checkVertical THEN
            RETURN dx*dx+dy*dy > mTouchSlop*mTouchSlop
        ELSE IF checkHorizontal THEN
            RETURN abs(dx) > mTouchSlop
        ELSE IF checkVertical THEN
            RETURN abs(dy) > mTouchSlop
        END IF
    ELSE
        RETURN FALSE
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION percolateUpMaxHeap(index)
    hole = index
    element = elements[hole]

    WHILE hole greater than 1 AND compare(element, elements[hole / 2]) greater than 0 THEN
        // save element that is being pushed down
        // as the element "bubble" is percolated up
        next = hole / 2
        setElement( hole, elements[next] )
        hole = next
    END WHILE

    setElement( hole, element )

PRIVATE SYNCHRONIZED FUNCTION returnTransport(returning)
    LONG now = SYSTEM.CURRENTTIMEMILLIS()
    PooledTransport unwrapped

    IF returning IS INSTANCEOF LeasedTransport THEN
        LeasedTransport leasedTransport = (LeasedTransport) returning
    ELSE IF returning IS INSTANCEOF PooledTransport THEN
        PooledTransport pooledTransport = (PooledTransport) returning
    ELSE
        THROW new EsHadoopIllegalStateException("Cannot return a non-poolable Transport to the pool")
    ENDIF

    IF leased.CONTAINSKEY(unwrapped) THEN
        leased.REMOVE(unwrapped)
        idle.PUT(unwrapped, now)
    ELSE
        THROW new EsHadoopIllegalStateException("Cannot return a Transport object to a pool that was not sourced from the pool")
    ENDIF
END FUNCTION

docstring:
Updades the cached required declaration array

@param constraint
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION updateRequiredDeclarations(constraint)
    DECLARE decs as Declaration[] = constraint.getRequiredDeclarations()
    IF decs is not null AND decs has length greater than 0 THEN
        FOR dec1 IN decs DO
            DECLARE dec AS Declaration = dec1
            FOR requiredDeclaration IN this.requiredDeclarations DO
                IF dec equals requiredDeclaration THEN
                    DEC = NULL
                    BREAK
                END IF
            END FOR
            IF dec is not null THEN
                DECLARE tmp as Declaration[] = this.requiredDeclarations
                THIS.requiredDeclarations = NEW Declaration[tmp.length + 1]
                COPY tmp TO THIS.requiredDeclarations FROM INDEX 0 TO LENGTH OF tmp
                THIS.requiredDeclarations[THIS.requiredDeclarations.length - 1] = dec
            END IF
        END FOR
    END IF
END FUNCTION

def createZone(zone, options):
    # Create a callback to handle the response
    def createZoneCallback(options, result, exception, isCreate):
        if exception:
            result.setException(exception)
            return

FUNCTION getAt(array, range)
    RangeInfo info = subListBorders(array.length, range)
    answer = primitiveArrayGet(array, new IntRange(true, info.from, info.to - 1))
    IF info.reverse is true THEN
        answer = reverse(answer)
    END IF
    RETURN answer
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION subListBorders(len, range)
    FROM = max(range.start, 0)
    TO = min(range.end, len)
    reverse = false
    IF FROM > TO THEN
        reverse = true
        temp = FROM
        FROM = TO
        TO = temp
    END IF
    RETURN RangeInfo(FROM, TO, reverse)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION primitiveArrayGet(array, range)
    result = empty list
    FOR i from range.start to range.end by 1
        result.add(array[i])
    END FOR
    RETURN result
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION reverse(list)
    FOR i from 0 to (list.size / 2) by 1
        temp = list[i]
        list[i] = list[list.size - i - 1]
        list[list.size - i - 1] = temp
    END FOR
    RETURN list
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION extractQuotedValueFromHeader(header, key)
    SET keypos = 0
    SET pos = -1
    SET whiteSpace = True
    SET inQuotes = False

    FOR i = 0 TO LENGTH(header)-1 MINUS 1 STEP 1
        SET C = header[i]
        IF inQuotes THEN
            IF C equals '"' THEN
                SET inQuotes = False
        ELSE
            IF key[keypos] equals C AND (whiteSpace OR keypos > 0) THEN
                INCREMENT keypos
                SET whiteSpace = False
            ELSE IF C equals '"' THEN
                SET keypos = 0
                SET inQuotes = True
                SET whiteSpace = False
            ELSE
                SET keypos = 0
                SET whiteSpace = C equals ' ' OR C equals ';' OR C equals '\t'
            ENDIF

            IF keypos equals keyLength THEN
                IF header[i+1] equals '=' THEN
                    SET pos = i+2
                    BREAK
                ELSE
                    SET keypos = 0
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR

    IF pos equals -1 THEN
        RETURN NULL
    ENDIF

    SET end
    SET start = pos
    IF header[start] equals '"' THEN
        INCREMENT start
        FOR end = start TO LENGTH(header) STEP 1
            SET C = header[end]
            IF C equals '"' THEN
                BREAK
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        RETURN SUBSTRING(header, start, end)

    ELSE
        //no quotes
        FOR end = start TO LENGTH(header) STEP 1
            SET C = header[end]
            IF C equals ' ' OR C equals '\t' OR C equals ';' THEN
                BREAK
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        RETURN SUBSTRING(header, start, end)
    ENDIF
END FUNCTION

docstring:
A convenient blocking call that can be used, typically during index creation, to wait for the index to become active by polling the table every 5 seconds.

Currently online index creation is only supported for Global Secondary Index (GSI). Calling this method on a Local Secondary Index (LSI) would result in IllegalArgumentException. @return the table description when the index has become active @throws IllegalArgumentException if the table is being deleted, or if the GSI is not being created or updated, or if the GSI doesn't exist @throws ResourceNotFoundException if the table doesn't exist
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION waitForActive()
    FOR
        TABLE table = GETTABLE()
        STRING tableName = TABLE.getTABLENAME()
        STRING indexName = GETINDEXNAME()
        RETRY: FOR
            TABLEDESCRIPTION desc = TABLE.WAITFORACTIVE()
            LIST<GLOBALSECONDARYINDEXDESCRIPTION> list = DESC.GETGLOBALSECONDARYINDEXES()
            IF list IS NOT NULL THEN
                FOR GLOBALSECONDARYINDEXDESCRIPTION D IN LIST DO
                    IF D.GETINDEXNAME() EQUALS INDEXNAME THEN
                        STRING STATUS = D.GETINDEXSTATUS()
                        SWITCH STATUS
                            CASE ACTIVE:
                                RETURN DESC
                            CASE CREATING:
                            CASE UPDATING:
                                THREAD.SLEEP(SLEEP_TIME_MILLIS)
                                CONTINUE RETRY
                            DEFAULT:
                                THROW ILLIGALARGUMENTEXCEPTION(
                                    "Global Secondary Index "
                                    + INDEXNAME
                                    + " is not being created or updated (with status="
                                    + STATUS + ")")
                        END SWITCH
                    END IF
                END FOR
            END IF
            THROW ILLIGALARGUMENTEXCEPTION("Global Secondary Index "
                    + INDEXNAME + " does not exist in Table " + TABLENAME + ")")
    END FOR
END FUNCTION

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

def wait_for_active(table_name, index_name, sleep_time_millis=5000):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

    while True:
        try:
            table_description = table.describe_table()
            index_descriptions = table_description['GlobalSecondaryIndexes']
            if index_descriptions is not None:
                index_status = list(filter(lambda x: x['IndexName'] == index_name, index_descriptions))[0]['IndexStatus']
                if index_status == 'ACTIVE':
                    return table_description
                elif index_status == 'CREATING' or index_status == 'UPDATING':
                    time.sleep(sleep_time_millis / 1000)
                    continue
                else:
                    raise ClientError(
                        "Global Secondary Index "
                        + index_name
                        + " is not being created or updated (with status="
                        + index_status + ")")
            raise ClientError(
                "Global Secondary Index "
                + index_name + " does not exist in Table " + table_name + ")")
        except ClientError as e:
            print(e)
            raise

FUNCTION findPipelineToMigrate(imbalance)
    SET candidates = imbalance.getPipelinesOwnedBy(imbalance.srcOwner)
    SET migrationThreshold = (long)(imbalance.maximumLoad - imbalance.minimumLoad)*MAXIMUM_NO_OF_EVENTS_AFTER_MIGRATION_COEFFICIENT
    SET candidate = NULL
    SET loadInSelectedPipeline = 0
    FOR pipeline IN candidates
        SET load = imbalance.getLoad(pipeline)
        IF load > loadInSelectedPipeline THEN
            IF load < migrationThreshold THEN
                SET loadInSelectedPipeline = load
                SET candidate = pipeline
            END IF
        END IF
    END FOR
    RETURN candidate
END FUNCTION

def find_pipeline_to_migrate(imbalance):
    # Get pipelines owned by the source owner
    candidates = imbalance.get_pipelines_owned_by(imbalance.src_owner)

    # Calculate the migration threshold
    migration_threshold = (imbalance.maximum_load - imbalance.minimum_load) * MAXIMUM_NO_OF_EVENTS_AFTER_MIGRATION_COEFFICIENT

    # Find the pipeline with the maximum load and is below the migration threshold
    candidate = None
    load_in_selected_pipeline = 0
    for pipeline in candidates:
        load = imbalance.get_load(pipeline)
        if load > load_in_selected_pipeline:
            if load < migration_threshold:
                load_in_selected_pipeline = load
                candidate = pipeline

    return candidate

from functools import reduce

def find_pipeline_to_migrate(imbalance):
    # Get pipelines owned by the source owner
    candidates = imbalance.get_pipelines_owned_by(imbalance.src_owner)

    # Calculate the migration threshold
    migration_threshold = (imbalance.maximum_load - imbalance.minimum_load) * MAXIMUM_NO_OF_EVENTS_AFTER_MIGRATION_COEFFICIENT

    # Find the pipeline with the maximum load and is below the migration threshold
    return reduce(lambda a, b: a if imbalance.get_load(a) > imbalance.get_load(b) else b, candidates) if reduce(lambda a, b: imbalance.get_load(a) < migration_threshold, candidates) else None

STATIC SET abstractMethodsIn(methods)
    SET noArgMethods = {}
    SET abstracts = {}
    FOR method IN methods
        IF method.modifiers contains ABSTRACT
            HASARGS = NOT method.parameters empty
            IF HASARGS OR noArgMethods.add(method.simpleName)
                abstracts.add(method)
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN abstracts
END STATIC

docstring: Returns the UNIX timestamp at which we must stop scanning.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION getScanEndTimeSeconds()
    begin_raw = getEndTime()
    end = begin_raw
    if ((end & SECOND_MASK) != 0) then
        end = end / 1000
        if (end - (end * 1000) < 1) then
            end++
        end if
    end if
    if (rollup_query != NULL) then
        return RollupUtils.getRollupBasetime(end + 
            (rollup_query.getRollupInterval().getIntervalSeconds() * 
                rollup_query.getRollupInterval().getIntervals()), 
            rollup_query.getRollupInterval())
    end if
    if (downsampler != NULL AND downsampler.getInterval() > 0) then
        interval_offset = (1000L * end) % downsampler.getInterval()
        interval_aligned_ts = end +
            (downsampler.getInterval() - interval_offset) / 1000L
        if (interval_aligned_ts = 0) then
            return interval_aligned_ts
        end if
        timespan_offset = interval_aligned_ts % MAX_TIMESPAN
        if (timespan_offset = 0) then
            return interval_aligned_ts
        end if
        return interval_aligned_ts + (MAX_TIMESPAN - timespan_offset)
    else
        timespan_offset = end % MAX_TIMESPAN
        if (timespan_offset = 0) then
            return end
        end if
        return end + (MAX_TIMESPAN - timespan_offset)
    end if
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION synthesize(token, posTag, posTagRegExp)
    IF posTag does not equal NULL AND posTagRegExp is TRUE THEN
        LET myPosTag be the substring of posTag from the start up to the last occurrence of ADD_IND_DETERMINER minus "\\"
        LET det be an empty string

        IF posTag ends with ADD_IND_DETERMINER THEN
            LET myPosTag be the substring of posTag from the start up to the last occurrence of ADD_IND_DETERMINER minus "\\"
            LET det be the substring of aVsAnRule.suggestAorAn(token.getLemma()) from the start up to the first occurrence of ' ' plus " ".length()
            LET det be the substring of det from the start up to the first occurrence of ' '
        ELSE IF posTag ends with ADD_DETERMINER THEN
            LET myPosTag be the substring of posTag from the start up to the last occurrence of ADD_DETERMINER minus "\\"
            LET det be "the "

        CALL initPossibleTags()
        DECLARE p as a Pattern matching myPosTag
        DECLARE results as an empty list
        FOR each tag in possibleTags DO
            DECLARE m as a Matcher for p on tag
            IF m matches then
                CALL lookup(token.getLemma(), tag, results, det)
        END FOR
        RETURN results as an array of strings
    END IF
    RETURN synthesize(token, posTag)
END FUNCTION

def buildForFragment():
    if self.mUsed:
        raise RuntimeError("you must not reuse a DrawerBuilder builder")
    if self.mActivity is None:
        raise RuntimeError("please pass an activity")
    if self.mRootView is None:
        raise RuntimeError("please pass the view which should host the DrawerLayout")

    # set that this builder was used. now you have to create a new one
    self.mUsed = True
    # if the user has not set a drawerLayout use the default one :D
    if self.mDrawerLayout is None:
        self.mDrawerLayout = DrawerLayout(-1)

    # set the drawer here...
    originalContentView = self.mRootView.getChildAt(0)

    alreadyInflated = originalContentView.getId() == R.id.materialize_root

    # only add the new layout if it wasn't done before
    if not alreadyInflated:
        # remove the contentView
        self.mRootView.removeView(originalContentView)
    else:
        # if it was already inflated we have to clean up again
        self.mRootView.removeAllViews()

    # create the layoutParams to use for the contentView
    layoutParamsContentView = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
        FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
        FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
    )

    # add the drawer
    self.mRootView.addView(self.mDrawerLayout, layoutParamsContentView)

    # set the id so we can check if it was already inflated
    self.mDrawerLayout.setId(R.id.materialize_root)

    # handle the navigation stuff of the ActionBarDrawerToggle and the drawer in general
    self.handleDrawerNavigation(self.mActivity, False)

    # build the view which will be set to the drawer
    result = self.buildView()

    # add the slider to the drawer
    self.mDrawerLayout.addView(originalContentView, 0)

    # define id for the sliderLayout
    self.mSliderLayout.setId(R.id.material_drawer_slider_layout)
    # add the slider to the drawer
    self.mDrawerLayout.addView(self.mSliderLayout, 1)

    return result

Returns a timestamp bound that will perform reads and queries at a timestamp chosen to be at most {@code num units} stale. This guarantees that all writes that have committed more than the specified number of seconds ago are visible. Because Cloud Spanner chooses the exact timestamp, this mode works even if the client's local clock is substantially skewed from Cloud Spanner commit timestamps.

Useful for reading the freshest data available at a nearby replica, while bounding the possible staleness if the local replica has fallen behind.

Note that this option can only be used in single-use reads and single-use read-only transactions.

    IF statusCode is less than zero OR greater than 999 THEN

            ENDIF

        ENDIF
    ENDIF

FUNCTION parse(name, stream)
    READER reader <- NEW IOSTREAM READER(stream)
    LINE line <- READER READLINE()

    IF line IS NULL THEN
        THROW IOEXCEPTION("EMPTY DATA SOURCE.")
    END IF
    
    TOKENS tokens <- SPLIT(line, "\t")
    INT p <- (tokens LENGTH - 2) DIV 2
    LINE line <- READER READLINE()

    IF line IS NULL THEN
        THROW IOEXCEPTION("PREMATURE END OF FILE.")
    END IF
    
    TOKENS samples <- SPLIT(line, "\t")
    IF samples LENGTH NOT EQUAL TO tokens LENGTH - 1 THEN
        THROW IOEXCEPTION("INVALID SAMPLE DESCRIPTION HEADER.")
    END IF
    
    ATTRIBUTE[] attributes <- NEW ARRAY ATTRIBUTE[p]
    FOR INT i <- 0 TO p - 1 DO
        ATTRIBUTE attribute <- NEW NUMERICATTRIBUTE(tokens[2 * i + 2], samples[2 * i + 1])
        attributes[i] <- attribute
    END FOR

    LINE line <- READER READLINE()
    IF line IS NULL THEN
        THROW IOEXCEPTION("PREMATURE END OF FILE.")
    END IF

    INT n <- PARSEINT(line)
    IF n LESS THAN OR EQUALS TO 0 THEN
        THROW IOEXCEPTION("INVALID NUMBER OF ROWS: " + n)            
    END IF
    
    ATTRIBUTEDATASET data <- NEW ATTRIBUTEDATASET(name, attributes)
    
    FOR INT i <- 0 TO n - 1 DO
        LINE line <- READER READLINE()
        IF line IS NULL THEN
            THROW IOEXCEPTION("PREMATURE END OF FILE.")
        END IF
    
        TOKENS tokens <- SPLIT(line, "\t")
        IF tokens LENGTH NOT EQUAL TO samples LENGTH + 1 THEN
            THROW IOEXCEPTION(String.format("INVALID NUMBER OF ELEMENTS OF LINE %d: %d", i + 4, tokens LENGTH))
        END IF

        DOUBLE[] x <- NEW ARRAY DOUBLE[p]
        FOR INT j <- 0 TO p - 1 DO
            x[j] <- PARSEDOUBLE(tokens[2 * j + 2])
        END FOR

        ATTRIBUTEDATASET.ROW datum <- data ADD(x)
        datum NAME <- tokens[1]
        datum DESCRIPTION <- tokens[0]
    END FOR
    
    READER CLOSE()
    RETURN data
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION copyState(object, context, strategy)
    IF object equals NULL THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION "object to set state cannot be null"
    ELSE IF context equals NULL THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION "context cannot be null"
    ELSE IF strategy equals NULL THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION "strategy cannot be null"

    FOR ALL fields IN allFields DO
        TRY
            SET internalState(isStaticField ? getType(object) : object, field.getType(), field.get(context))

            IF strategy equals STRICT THEN
                THROW EXCEPTION e
            END IF
        CATCH ILLEGAL_ACCESS_EXCEPTION e

        END CATCH
    END FOR

FUNCTION getTradeHistory(params)
    DECLARE limit AS LONG
    DECLARE currencyPair AS CURRENCY_PAIR
    DECLARE offset AS LONG
    DECLARE sort AS STRING

    IF params IS A INSTANCE OF TradeHistoryParamPaging THEN
        SET limit = params.getPageLength()
    ENDIF

    IF params IS A INSTANCE OF TradeHistoryParamOffset THEN
        SET offset = params.getOffset()
    ENDIF

    IF params IS A INSTANCE OF TradeHistoryParamsSorted THEN
        DECLARE order AS TradeHistoryParamsSorted.Order
        SET order = params.getOrder()

        IF order EQUALS TradeHistoryParamsSorted.Order.ASC THEN
            SET sort = 'asc'
        ELSE
            SET sort = 'desc'
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    IF params IS A INSTANCE OF TradeHistoryParamCurrencyPair THEN
        SET currencyPair = params.getCurrencyPair()
    ENDIF

    DECLARE txs AS QUADRIGA_CX_USER_TRANSACTION ARRAY
    SET txs = getQuadrigaCxUserTransactions(currencyPair, limit, offset, sort)

    RETURN adaptTradeHistory(txs, currencyPair)
END FUNCTION

def configure_global_file_log(config: RootLoggerConfig, log_dir: str, log_pattern: str):
    # Create a file appender
    file_appender = FileAppender()
    file_appender.set_file(os.path.join(log_dir, config.get_log_filename_prefix()))
    file_appender.set_name("FILE")
    file_appender.set_layout(PatternLayout(log_pattern))
    file_appender.set_threshold(Level.INFO)
    file_appender.activate_options()
    # Add the appender to the configuration

    # Add a reference to the appender
    appender_ref = file_appender.get_name()
    PUT_PROPERTY(f"{ROOT_LOGGER_NAME}.appenderRef.{appender_ref}.ref", appender_ref)

PUBLIC VOID ADD(BYTESREF PAYLOAD)
    DATA = PAYLOAD
    DATA ENTRIES = DATA ENTRIES + 1
    IF BUFFER ENTRIES THRESHOLD GREATER OR EQUALS 0 AND DATA ENTRIES GREATER OR EQUALS BUFFER ENTRIES THRESHOLD THEN
        IF AUTO FLUSH THEN
            FLUSH
        ELSE
            // handle the corner case of manual flush that occurs only after the buffer is completely full (think size of 1)
            IF DATA ENTRIES GREATER OR EQUALS BUFFER ENTRIES THRESHOLD THEN
                THROW NEW ESHADOOPISERROREXCEPTION(STRING FORMAT("AUTO FLUSH DISABLED AND MAXIMUM NUMBER OF ENTRIES SURPASSED; DISABLE MANUAL FLUSH OR INCREASE CAPACITY [CURRENT SIZE %S]; BAILING OUT",BUFFER ENTRIES THRESHOLD))
            END IF
        END IF
    END IF
END PUBLIC

FUNCTION analyzeDependency(dependency, engine)

        FOR ma IN mas
            LOGGER.debug("Artifactory analyzer found artifact ({}) for dependency ({})", ma, dependency.fileName)

docstring:
Convert getter into a property name
Example: 'getFoo' is converted into 'foo'

It's written defensively, when output is not a getter then it
returns the original name.

It only converts names starting with a get- prefix. When a getter
starts with an is- prefix (=boolean) then it does not convert it.

@param getterName
@return property matching the given getter
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION getterIntoProperty(getterName)
    IF getterName equals NULL THEN
        RETURN getterName
    END IF

    length = LENGTH(getterName)
    IF NOT getterName STARTS WITH "get" OR LENGTH IS LESS THAN "get".LENGTH THEN
        RETURN getterName
    END IF

    propertyName = SUBSTRING(getterName, "get".LENGTH, LENGTH)
    firstChar = CHARACTER(propertyName, 0)
    IF isLetter(firstChar) THEN
        IF isLowerCase(firstChar) THEN
            //ok, apparently this is not a JavaBean getter, better leave it untouched
            RETURN getterName
        END IF
        propertyName = TOLOWERCASE(CHARACTER(propertyName, 0)) + SUBSTRING(propertyName, 1, LENGTH - 1)
    END IF
    RETURN propertyName
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION resolveType(klass, packageDescr, pkgRegistry)

    arraySuffix := ""
    arrayIndex := indexInString(klass, "[")
    IF arrayIndex >= 0 THEN
        arraySuffix := substringFrom(arrayIndex, klass)
        klass := substringTo(arrayIndex, klass)
    ENDIF

    temp := klass
    WHILE temp > 0 DO
        FOR i := 0 TO sizeOf(packageDescr.getImports()) DO
            fqKlass := packageDescr.getImports()[i].getTarget()
            IF endsWith(fqKlass, temp) THEN
                fqKlass := substringBefore(fqKlass, temp) + klass
                RETURN arrayIndex < 0 ? fqKlass : fqKlass + arraySuffix
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR

        temp := substringBeforeLast(temp, ".")
    ENDWHILE

    pkgRegistry := NULL
    IF pkgRegistry NOT NULL THEN
        FOR declaredName IN pkgRegistry.getPackage().getTypeDeclarations().keySet() DO
            IF declaredName == klass THEN
                typeDeclaration := pkgRegistry.getPackage().getTypeDeclaration(declaredName)
                IF typeDeclaration.getTypeClass() != NULL THEN
                    klass := typeDeclaration.getTypeClass().getName()
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDIF

    IF (klass != NULL) AND (NOT contains(klass, ".")) AND (packageDescr.getNamespace() != NULL) AND (NOT isEmpty(packageDescr.getNamespace())) THEN
        FOR td IN packageDescr.getClassAndEnumDeclarationDescrs() DO
            IF klass == td.getTypeName() THEN
                IF td.getType().getFullName().contains(".") THEN
                    klass := td.getType().getFullName()
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDIF

    RETURN arrayIndex < 0 ? klass : klass + arraySuffix

END FUNCTION

FUNCTION relativePath(self, to)
    FROM_PATH = canonical_path(self)
    TO_PATH = canonical_path(to)

    // build the path stack info to compare
    FROM_PATH_STACK = getPathStack(FROM_PATH)
    TO_PATH_STACK = getPathStack(TO_PATH)

    IF LENGTH(TO_PATH_STACK) > 0 AND LENGTH(FROM_PATH_STACK) > 0 THEN
        IF FROM_PATH_STACK[0] NOT EQUALS TO_PATH_STACK[0] THEN
            // not the same device (would be "" on Linux/Unix)

            RETURN PATH(TO_PATH_STACK)
        END IF
    ELSE
        // no comparison possible
        RETURN PATH(TO_PATH_STACK)
    END IF

    MIN_LENGTH = MIN(LENGTH(FROM_PATH_STACK), LENGTH(TO_PATH_STACK))
    SAME = 1 // Used outside the for loop

    // get index of parts which are equal
    WHILE SAME < MIN_LENGTH AND FROM_PATH_STACK[SAME] EQUALS TO_PATH_STACK[SAME] DO
        SAME++
    END WHILE

    RELATIVE_PATH_STACK = NEW LIST()

    // if "from" part is longer, fill it up with ".."
    // to reach path which is equal to both paths
    FOR I FROM SAME TO LENGTH(FROM_PATH_STACK) DO
        RELATIVE_PATH_STACK.ADD("..")
    END FOR

    // fill it up path with parts which were not equal
    RELATIVE_PATH_STACK.ADD_ALL(TO_PATH_STACK.SUBLIST(SAME, LENGTH(TO_PATH_STACK)))

    RETURN PATH(RELATIVE_PATH_STACK)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION initEntryFact(fact)
    SET fact.valid TO TRUE
    CLEAR fact.stack
    IN MAIN METHOD ? in_main_method
    NUMBER OF SLOTS ? num_slots
    NUMBER OF LOCALS ? num_locals
    FOR i FROM 0 TO num_slots
        VALUE ? value
        IF i < num_locals THEN
            IF i < parameter_stack_size THEN
                STACK OFFSET ? stack_offset
                IS TAINTED BY ANNOTATION ? is_tainted_by_annotation
                IF is_tainted_by_annotation THEN
                    VALUE ? value
                    SET value.state TO TAINTED
                    // this would add line number for the first instruction in the method
                    //value.addLocation(new TaintLocation(methodDescriptor, 0,""), true);
                ELSE IF in_main_method THEN
                    IF FindSecBugsGlobalConfig.getInstance().isTaintedMainArgument() THEN
                        VALUE ? value
                        SET value.state TO TAINTED
                    ELSE
                        VALUE ? value
                        SET value.state TO SAFE
                    ENDIF
                ELSE
                    VALUE ? value
                    value.addParameter(stack_offset)
                ENDIF
                VALUE ? value
                value.addSource(new UnknownSource(UnknownSourceType.PARAMETER,value.getState()).setParameterIndex(stack_offset))
            ENDIF
            VALUE ? value
            value.setVariableIndex(i)
        ENDIF
        SET fact.value TO value
    ENDFOR
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION addExcludes(excludes)
    IF excludes NOT EQUALS NULL AND LENGTH OF excludes GREATER THAN 0 THEN
        IF this.excludes NOT EQUALS NULL AND LENGTH OF this.excludes GREATER THAN 0 THEN
            DECLARE tmp AS ARRAY OF STRING
            SET tmp TO NEW ARRAY WITH SIZE OF excludes + LENGTH OF this.excludes
            COPY FIRST LENGTH OF this.excludes ELEMENTS OF this.excludes INTO tmp
            FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF excludes DO
                SET tmp[LENGTH OF this.excludes + i] TO normalizePattern(excludes[i])
            END FOR
            SET this.excludes TO tmp
        ELSE
            SET this.excludes TO excludes
        END IF
    END IF
    RETURN this
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION normalizePattern(pattern)
    REPLACE ALL SLASHES IN pattern WITH File.separatorChar
    APPEND "**" TO pattern
    RETURN pattern
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION cacheBlockFromUfs(blockId, blockSize, openUfsBlockOptions)
    IF mBlockWorker.openUfsBlock(Sessions.ASYNC_CACHE_SESSION_ID, blockId, openUfsBlockOptions) THEN
        RETURN TRUE
    ELSE
        LOG.warn("Failed to async cache block {} from UFS on opening the block", blockId)
        RETURN FALSE
    END IF

    TRY
        WITH BlockReader reader = mBlockWorker.readUfsBlock(Sessions.ASYNC_CACHE_SESSION_ID, blockId, 0)
            WHILE offset < blockSize
                LONG bufferSize = Math.min(8 * Constants.MB, blockSize - offset)
                reader.read(offset, bufferSize)
                offset += bufferSize
            END WHILE
        END WITH
    CATCH AlluxioException | IOException e
        // This is only best effort
        LOG.warn("Failed to async cache block {} from UFS on copying the block: {}", blockId, e)
        RETURN FALSE
    FINALLY
        TRY
            mBlockWorker.closeUfsBlock(Sessions.ASYNC_CACHE_SESSION_ID, blockId)
        CATCH AlluxioException | IOException ee
            LOG.warn("Failed to close UFS block {}: {}", blockId, ee)
            RETURN FALSE
        END TRY
    END TRY
    RETURN TRUE
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION decodeNumberLax(minus)
    ARRAY array = charArray

    INTEGER startIndex = __index
    INTEGER index = __index
    CHARACTER currentChar
    BOOLEAN doubleFloat = FALSE
    BOOLEAN foundDot = FALSE
    BOOLEAN foundSign = FALSE
    BOOLEAN foundExp = FALSE

    IF minus AND index + 1 < array.length THEN
        index++
    ENDIF

    WHILE TRUE DO
        currentChar = array[index]
        IF isNumberDigit(currentChar) THEN
            // noop
        ELSIF currentChar <= 32 THEN
            BREAK
        ELSIF isDelimiter(currentChar) THEN
            BREAK
        ELSIF isDecimalChar(currentChar) THEN
            SWITCH currentChar DO
                CASE DECIMAL_POINT
                    IF foundDot OR foundExp THEN
                        RETURN decodeStringLax()
                    ENDIF
                    foundDot = TRUE
                CASE LETTER_E
                    CASE LETTER_BIG_E
                        IF foundExp THEN
                            RETURN decodeStringLax()
                        ENDIF
                        foundExp = TRUE
                CASE MINUS
                    CASE PLUS
                        IF foundSign OR NOT foundExp THEN
                            RETURN decodeStringLax()
                        ENDIF
                        IF foundExp AND array[index - 1] != LETTER_E AND array[index - 1] != LETTER_BIG_E THEN
                            RETURN decodeStringLax()
                        ENDIF
                        foundSign = TRUE
                OTHERWISE
                    RETURN decodeStringLax()
            ENDSWITCH
            doubleFloat = TRUE
        OTHERWISE
            RETURN decodeStringLax()
        ENDIF
        index++
        IF index >= array.length THEN
            BREAK
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE

    // Handle the case where the exponential number ends without the actual exponent
    IF foundExp THEN
        CHAR prevChar = array[index - 1]
        IF prevChar == LETTER_E OR prevChar == LETTER_BIG_E OR prevChar == MINUS OR prevChar == PLUS THEN
            RETURN decodeStringLax()
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    __index = index
    __currentChar = currentChar

    TYPE type = doubleFloat ? DOUBLE : INTEGER

    RETURN new NumberValue(chop, type, startIndex, __index, this.charArray)
END FUNCTION

def intercept_output(consoleId: int, callback: Callable[[bytes, int, int], bool]) -> None:
    # Write intercepted output to original console
    def write(b: bytes, off: int, len: int) -> None:
        # Call the callback function
        result = callback(b, off, len)
        # If the callback returns True, write the intercepted output to the original console
        if result:
            sys.stdout.write(b)

    # Replace the original write function with the intercepted write function
    sys.stdout.write = write

def new_decorator(circuit_breaker, strategy):
    # Create a new decorator that wraps the given circuit breaker instance
    def decorator(func):
        # Wrap the original function to handle the request
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            # Check if the circuit is open
            if circuit_breaker.is_open():
                # Raise an exception if the circuit is open
                raise Exception("Circuit is open")

            # Execute the original function
            result = func(*args, **kwargs)

            # Check if the circuit is half-open
            if circuit_breaker.is_half_open():
                # Execute the strategy
                strategy.execute()

            return result

        return wrapper

    return decorator

FUNCTION buildQueriesAsync(tsdb)
    DECLARE tsdb_queries AS ARRAY OF Query
    DECLARE deferreds AS LIST OF Deferred<Object>
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(queries)-1 DO
        DECLARE query AS Query
        SET query = tsdb.newQuery()
        APPEND deferreds WITH query.configureFromQuery(this, i)
        APPEND tsdb_queries WITH query
    END FOR
    CLASS GroupFinished IMPLEMENTS Callback<Query[], ArrayList<Object>>
        OVERRIDE call(deferreds)
            RETURN tsdb_queries
    END CLASS
    RETURN Deferred.group(deferreds).addCallback(new GroupFinished())
END FUNCTION

docstring:
This method will group all puts per partition and send a {@link com.hazelcast.map.impl.operation.PutAllPartitionAwareOperationFactory} per member.

If there are e.g. five keys for a single member, there will only be a single remote invocation instead of having five remote invocations.

There is also an optional support for batching to send smaller packages. Takes care about {@code null} checks for keys and values.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION putAllInternal(map)
    TRY
        SET mapSize TO map.size()

        IF mapSize equals 0 THEN
            RETURN
        END IF

        SET useBatching TO isPutAllUseBatching(mapSize)
        SET partitionCount TO partitionService.getPartitionCount()
        SET initialSize TO getPutAllInitialSize(useBatching, mapSize, partitionCount)

        SET memberPartitionsMap TO partitionService.getMemberPartitionsMap()

        // init counters for batching
        SET counterPerMember TO new MutableLong[partitionCount]
        SET addresses TO new Address[partitionCount]
        FOR addressListEntry IN memberPartitionsMap.entrySet() DO
            SET counter TO new MutableLong()
            SET address TO addressListEntry.getKey()
            FOR partitionId IN addressListEntry.getValue() DO
                counterPerMember[partitionId] = counter
                addresses[partitionId] = address
            END FOR
        END FOR

        // fill entriesPerPartition
        SET entriesPerPartition TO new MapEntries[partitionCount]
        FOR entry IN map.entrySet() DO
            CALL checkNotNull(entry.getKey(), NULL_KEY_IS_NOT_ALLOWED)
            CALL checkNotNull(entry.getValue(), NULL_VALUE_IS_NOT_ALLOWED)

            SET keyData TO toDataWithStrategy(entry.getKey())
            SET partitionId TO partitionService.getPartitionId(keyData)
            SET entries TO entriesPerPartition[partitionId]

            IF entries IS NULL THEN
                SET entries TO new MapEntries(initialSize)
                entriesPerPartition[partitionId] = entries
            END IF

            CALL entries.add(keyData, toData(entry.getValue()))

            IF useBatching THEN
                SET currentSize TO ++counterPerMember[partitionId].value
                IF currentSize modulo putAllBatchSize equals 0 THEN
                    SET partitions TO memberPartitionsMap.get(addresses[partitionId])
                    CALL invokePutAllOperation(partitions, entriesPerPartition)
                END IF
            END IF
        END FOR

        // invoke operations for entriesPerPartition
        FOR entry IN memberPartitionsMap.entrySet() DO
            SET partitions TO entry.getValue()
            CALL invokePutAllOperation(partitions, entriesPerPartition)
        END FOR

        CALL finalizePutAll(map)
    CATCH e
        THROW rethrow(e)
    END TRY
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION armeriaServer(armeriaSettings,meterRegistry,meterIdPrefixFunctionFactory,healthCheckers,
                       armeriaServerConfigurators,thriftServiceRegistrationBeans,httpServiceRegistrationBeans,
                       annotatedServiceRegistrationBeans)
    IF NOT armeriaServerConfigurators IS PRESENT AND NOT thriftServiceRegistrationBeans IS PRESENT
       AND NOT httpServiceRegistrationBeans IS PRESENT AND NOT annotatedServiceRegistrationBeans IS PRESENT
       THEN
        // No services to register, no need to start up armeria server.
        RETURN NULL
    END IF

    IF armeriaSettings.isEnableMetrics() THEN
        meterIdPrefixFuncFactory = meterIdPrefixFunctionFactory.orElse(DEFAULT)
    ELSE
        meterIdPrefixFuncFactory = NULL
    END IF

    server = new ServerBuilder()

    ports = armeriaSettings.getPorts()
    IF ports IS EMPTY THEN
        server.port(new ServerPort(DEFAULT_PORT.getPort(), DEFAULT_PORT.getProtocols()))
    ELSE
        configurePorts(server,ports)
    END IF

    configureThriftServices(server,thriftServiceRegistrationBeans.orElseGet(Collections::emptyList),
                            meterIdPrefixFuncFactory,armeriaSettings.getDocsPath())
    configureHttpServices(server,httpServiceRegistrationBeans.orElseGet(Collections::emptyList),
                          meterIdPrefixFuncFactory)
    configureAnnotatedHttpServices(server,annotatedServiceRegistrationBeans.orElseGet(Collections::emptyList),
                                   meterIdPrefixFuncFactory)
    configureServerWithArmeriaSettings(server,armeriaSettings,
                                       meterRegistry.orElse(Metrics.globalRegistry),
                                       healthCheckers.orElseGet(Collections::emptyList))

    FOR configurators IN armeriaServerConfigurators DO
        configurator = configurators
        configurator.configure(server)
    END FOR

    s = server.build()
    s.start().handle((result,t) -> {
        IF t IS NOT NULL THEN
            THROW new IllegalStateException("Armeria server failed to start", t)
        END IF
        RETURN result
    }).join()
    logger.info("Armeria server started at ports: {}", s.activePorts())
    RETURN s
END FUNCTION

docstring: Reads the {@link InputStream file} and converting it to {@link String} using UTF-8 encoding.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION readFile(file)
    TRY
        WITH stream = BufferedInputStream(file)
            BUFF = [1024]
            BUILDER = STRINGBUILDER()
            READ = INTEGER()
            WHILE READ is NOT EQUAL TO -1 DO
                APPEND BUILDER BY NEW STRING(BUFF, 0, READ, STANDARDCHARSET.UTF-8)
                READ = stream.read(BUFF)
            END WHILE
            RETURN BUILDER.toString()
        CATCH
            THROW RUNTIMEEXCEPTION()
        FINALLY
            CLOSE stream
        END CATCH
    END TRY
END FUNCTION

docstring:
Updates the item at the given index and calls {@link Callback#onChanged(int, int)} and/or {@link Callback#onMoved(int, int)} if necessary.

You can use this method if you need to change an existing Item such that its position in the list may change.

If the new object is a different object (get(index) != item) and {@link Callback#areContentsTheSame(Object, Object)} returns true, SortedList avoids calling {@link Callback#onChanged(int, int)} otherwise it calls {@link Callback#onChanged(int, int)}.

If the new position of the item is different than the provided index, SortedList calls {@link Callback#onMoved(int, int)}. @param index The index of the item to replace @param item The item to replace the item at the given Index. @see #add(Object)

FUNCTION updateItemAt(index, item)
    existing = get(index)
    contentsChanged = (existing != item) && areContentsTheSame(existing, item)
    IF contentsChanged THEN
        CALL onChanged(index, 1)
    END IF
    CALL removeItemAtIndex(index, false)
    newIndex = CALL add(item, false)
    IF index != newIndex THEN
        CALL onMoved(index, newIndex)
    END IF
END FUNCTION

def consume(seq):
    # Check if the sequence matches the expected sequence
    if not matches(seq):
        raise IllegalStateError("Queue did not match expected sequence")

    # Calculate the length of the sequence
    length = len(seq)

    # Check if the sequence is longer than the remaining length of the queue
    if length > len(self.queue):
        raise IllegalStateError("Queue not long enough to consume sequence")

    # Increment the position by the length of the sequence
    self.position += length

docstring: Inverse discrete wavelet transform.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION inverse(a)
    SET n to length of a

    IF n is not a power of 2 THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION "The data vector size is not a power of 2."
    ENDIF

    IF n is less than wavelet coefficient size THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION "The data vector size is less than wavelet coefficient size."
    ENDIF

    SET start to n right shifted by floor of log base 2 of n divided by wavelet coefficient size minus one

    FOR nn from start to n left shifted by one
        CALL backward with parameters a and nn
    NEXT nn
END FUNCTION

docstring:
This determines which clusters all data that are rooted node will be
assigned to, and updates sums, counts and membership (if not null)
accordingly. Candidates maintains the set of cluster indices which
could possibly be the closest clusters for data in this subtree.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION filter(node, centroids, candidates, k, sums, counts, membership)
    DECLARE minDist AS DOUBLE, closest AS INT, newCandidates AS INT[], newk AS INT

    SET minDist TO Math.squaredDistance(node.center, centroids[candidates[0]])
    SET closest TO candidates[0]

    FOR i FROM 1 TO k DO
        SET dist TO Math.squaredDistance(node.center, centroids[candidates[i]])
        IF dist LESS THAN minDist THEN
            SET minDist TO dist
            SET closest TO candidates[i]
        END IF
    END FOR

    IF node.lower NOT EQUAL NULL THEN
        DECLARE newCandidates AS INT[]

        SET newk TO 0

        FOR i FROM 0 TO k DO
            IF NOT prune(node.center, node.radius, centroids, closest, candidates[i]) THEN
                SET newCandidates[newk++] TO candidates[i]
            END IF
        END FOR

        IF newk GREATER THAN 1 THEN
            SET result TO filter(node.lower, centroids, newCandidates, newk, sums, counts, membership) + filter(node.upper, centroids, newCandidates, newk, sums, counts, membership)

            RETURN result
        END IF
    END IF

    FOR i FROM 0 TO d DO
        SET sums[closest][i] TO sums[closest][i] + node.sum[i]
    END FOR

    SET counts[closest] TO counts[closest] + node.count

    IF membership NOT EQUAL NULL THEN
        DECLARE last AS INT

        SET last TO node.index + node.count

        FOR i FROM node.index TO last DO
            SET membership[index[i]] TO closest
        END FOR
    END IF

    SET result TO getNodeCost(node, centroids[closest])

    RETURN result
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION ruleMatchesToXmlSnippet(ruleMatches, text, contextSize)
    DECLARE xml
    SET xml = ""
    //
    // IMPORTANT: people rely on this format, don't change it!
    //
    SET contextTools = NEW ContextTools()
    SET contextTools.setEscapeHtml(FALSE)
    SET contextTools.setContextSize(contextSize)
    SET startMarker = "__languagetool_start_marker"
    SET contextTools.setErrorMarkerStart(startMarker)
    SET contextTools.setErrorMarkerEnd("")
    FOR EACH match IN ruleMatches
        SET subId = ""
        IF match.getRule() INSTANCEOF AbstractPatternRule THEN
            SET pRule = CAST(match.getRule(), AbstractPatternRule)
            IF pRule.getSubId() NOT NULL THEN
                SET subId = " subId=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(pRule.getSubId()) + "\" "
        ENDIF
        SET xml += "<error fromy=\"" + match.getLine() + '" + "fromx=\"" + match.getColumn() - 1 + '" + "toy=\"" + match.getEndLine() + '" + "tox=\"" + match.getEndColumn() - 1 + '" + "ruleId=\"" + match.getRule().getId() + '"'
        SET xml += subId
        SET msg = match.getMessage().replaceAll("</?suggestion>", "'")
        SET xml += " msg=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(msg) + '" + "replacements=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(String.join("#", match.getSuggestedReplacements())) + '"'
        IF !match.getShortMessage().isEmpty() THEN
            SET xml += " shortmsg=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(match.getShortMessage()) + '"'
        ENDIF
        SET context = contextTools.getContext(match.getFromPos(), match.getToPos(), text)
        // get position of error in context and remove artificial marker again:
        SET contextOffset = context.indexOf(startMarker)
        SET context = context.replaceFirst(startMarker, "")
        SET context = context.replaceAll("[\n\r]", " ")
        SET xml += " context=\"" + escapeForXmlAttribute(context) + '" + "contextoffset=\"" + contextOffset + '"' + " offset=\"" + match.getFromPos() + '"' + " errorlength=\"" + (match.getToPos() - match.getFromPos()) + '"'
        IF match.getRule().getUrl() NOT NULL THEN
            SET xml += " url=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(match.getRule().getUrl().toString()) + '"'
        ENDIF
        SET category = match.getRule().getCategory()
        IF category NOT NULL THEN
            SET xml += " category=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(category.getName()) + '"'
            SET id = category.getId()
            IF id NOT NULL THEN
                SET xml += " categoryid=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(id.toString()) + '"'
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
        SET type = match.getRule().getLocQualityIssueType()
        IF type NOT NULL THEN
            SET xml += " locqualityissuetype=\"" + escapeXMLForAPIOutput(type.toString()) + '"'
        ENDIF
        SET xml += "/>\n"
    ENDFOR
    RETURN xml
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION commitBlock(workerId, usedBytesOnTier, tierAlias, blockId, length)
    IF workerId NOT IN mWorkers THEN
        THROW NotFoundException("No worker found for workerId")
    END IF

    LOCK worker

    IF blockId NOT IN mBlockStore THEN
        IF blockId IN mBlockStore AND blockId.getLength() != Constants.UNKNOWN_SIZE THEN
            LOG.WARN("Rejecting attempt to change block length from {} to {}",
                blockId.getLength(), length)
        ELSE
            mBlockStore.putBlock(blockId, BlockMeta.newBuilder().setLength(length).build())
            blockInfo = BlockInfoEntry.newBuilder().setBlockId(blockId).setLength(length).build()
            journalContext.append(JournalEntry.newBuilder().setBlockInfo(blockInfo).build())
        END IF
    END IF

    mBlockStore.addLocation(blockId, BlockLocation.newBuilder()
        .setWorkerId(workerId)
        .setTier(tierAlias)
        .build())

    mLostBlocks.remove(blockId)

    worker.addBlock(blockId)
    worker.updateUsedBytes(tierAlias, usedBytesOnTier)
    worker.updateLastUpdatedTimeMs()
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION registerMonitoringFilter(properties,servletContext)
    // Create the monitoring filter and set its configuration parameters.
    IF properties.isManagementEndpointMonitoringEnabled() THEN
        // if the management endpoint is enabled, disable the /monitoring reports on the application port
        filter = NEW MonitoringFilter()
            OVERRIDE isAllowed(request,response)
                RESPONSE.SENDERROR(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,"Forbidden access")
                RETURN FALSE
            END METHOD
        END IF
    ELSE
        filter = NEW MonitoringFilter()
        END METHOD
    END IF
    FILTER = NEW MonitoringFilter()
    SET filter.applicationType("Spring Boot")

    // Wrap the monitoring filter in the registration bean.
    REGISTRATIONBEAN = NEW FilterRegistrationBean()
    REGISTRATIONBEAN.SETFILTER(filter)
    REGISTRATIONBEAN.SETASYNCSUPPORTED(TRUE)
    REGISTRATIONBEAN.SETNAME("javamelody")
    REGISTRATIONBEAN.SETDISPATCHERTYPES(DispatcherType.REQUEST,DispatcherType.ASYNC)

    // Set the initialization parameter for the monitoring filter.
    FOR parameter IN properties.initParameters
        REGISTRATIONBEAN.ADDINITPARAMETER(parameter.key,parameter.value)
    END FOR

    // Set the URL patterns to activate the monitoring filter for.
    REGISTRATIONBEAN.ADDURLPATTERNS("/*")

    FILTERREGISTRATION = servletContext.getFilterRegistration("javamelody")
    IF FILTERREGISTRATION NOT NULL THEN
        // if webapp deployed as war in a container with MonitoringFilter already added by web-fragment.xml,
        // do not try to add it again
        REGISTRATIONBEAN.ENABLE(FALSE)
        FOR entry IN REGISTRATIONBEAN.INITPARAMETERS
            FILTERREGISTRATION.SETINITPARAMETER(entry.KEY,entry.VALUE)
        END FOR
    END IF
    RETURN REGISTRATIONBEAN
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION getParserForMIMEType(mimeType)
    cleanMime <- mimeType
    IF null != mimeType AND mimeType.indexOf(";") > 0 THEN
        cleanMime <- mimeType.substring(0, mimeType.indexOf(";"))
    END IF
    IF !validMimeType(cleanMime) THEN
        THROW IllegalArgumentException("Invalid MIME type: "+ mimeType)
    END IF
    FOR resourceFormatParser IN listParsers()
        IF null != resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes()
            IF resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes().contains(cleanMime) THEN
                RETURN resourceFormatParser
            ELSE
                FOR s IN resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes()
                    IF validMimeType(s) AND s.startsWith("*/") THEN
                        t1 <- s.substring(2)
                        t2 <- cleanMime.substring(cleanMime.indexOf("/")+1)
                        IF t1.equals(t2) THEN
                            RETURN resourceFormatParser
                        END IF
                    END IF
                END FOR
            END IF
        END IF
    END FOR
    THROW UnsupportedFormatException("No provider available to parse MIME type: " + mimeType)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION screeplot(pca)
    n = pca.getVarianceProportion().length

    lowerBound = [0, 0.0]
    upperBound = [n+1, 1.0]

    canvas = new PlotCanvas(lowerBound, upperBound, false)
    canvas.setAxisLabels('Principal Component', 'Proportion of Variance')

    labels = []
    x = []
    data = []
    data2 = []

    FOR i FROM 0 TO n DO
        labels[i] = 'PC' + (i+1)
        x[i] = i+1
        data[i][0] = x[i]
        data[i][1] = pca.getVarianceProportion()[i]
        data2[i][0] = x[i]
        data2[i][1] = pca.getCumulativeVarianceProportion()[i]
    END FOR

    plot = new LinePlot(data)
    plot.setID('Variance')
    plot.setColor(Color.RED)
    plot.setLegend('@')
    canvas.add(plot)
    canvas.getAxis(0).addLabel(labels, x)

    plot2 = new LinePlot(data2)
    plot2.setID('Cumulative Variance')
    plot2.setColor(Color.BLUE)
    plot2.setLegend('@')
    canvas.add(plot2)
    
    RETURN canvas
END FUNCTION

    END IF

FUNCTION putAt(self, splice, values)
    IF splice is empty THEN
        IF values is not empty THEN
            THROW EXCEPTION "Trying to replace 0 elements with " + size of values + " elements"
        ELSE
            RETURN
        END IF
    ELSE
        GET first element from splice
        IF first is an instance of Integer THEN
            IF size of values is not equal to size of splice THEN
                THROW EXCEPTION "Trying to replace " + size of splice + " elements with " + size of values + " elements"
            ELSE
                FOR each index in splice DO
                    PUT index into self
                END FOR
            END IF
        ELSE
            THROW EXCEPTION "Can only index a List with another List of Integers, not a List of " + first.getClass().getName()
        END IF
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION getPath(parts)
    IF parts is null OR parts is empty THEN
        THROW IllegalArgumentException("Parts is null or empty.")
    ENDIF

    DECLARE builder AS STRING
    FOR i FROM 0 TO length(parts)-1 DO
        DECLARE part AS STRING
        SET part = parts[i]
        SET builder = builder + part

        DECLARE hasMore AS BOOLEAN
        SET hasMore = i < length(parts)-1
        IF NOT part ends with File.separator AND hasMore THEN
            SET builder = builder + File.separator
        ENDIF
    END FOR

    RETURN builder
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION migrate(service, target, maxConfiguredReplicaCount)
    IF Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() THEN
        RETURN FALSE
    ENDIF
    DECLARE variable operationService AS OperationService
    DECLARE variable migrationOperation AS CRDTReplicationContainer
    DECLARE variable allMigrated AS Boolean

    SET migrationOperation = service.prepareMigrationOperation(maxConfiguredReplicaCount)
    IF migrationOperation IS NULL THEN
        RETURN TRUE
    ENDIF
    TRY
        LOG(FINEST, "Migrating " + service.getName() + " to " + target)
        SET allMigrated = service.clearCRDTState(migrationOperation.getVectorClocks())
        IF !allMigrated THEN
            LOG(FINE, service.getName() + " CRDTs have been mutated since migrated to target " + target
                    + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).")
        ENDIF
        RETURN allMigrated
    CATCH e AS Exception
        IF logger.isFineEnabled() THEN
            LOG(FINE, "Failed migration of " + service.getName() + " for target " + target
                    + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).", e)
        ELSE
            LOG(INFO, "Failed migration of " + service.getName() + " for target " + target
                    + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).")
        ENDCATCH
        RETURN FALSE
    ENDTRY
END FUNCTION

To restore the max-heap condition when a node's priority is increased.
We move up the heap, exchaning the node at position k with its parent
(at postion k/2) if necessary, continuing as long as a[k/2] < a[k] or
until we reach the top of the heap.

FUNCTION siftUp(arr, k)
    WHILE k greater than 1 AND arr[k/2] less than arr[k]
        SWAP arr[k], arr[k/2]
        SET k equal k divided by 2

FUNCTION explodeAPIPath()
    DECLARE split AS ARRAY OF STRING
    SET split = explodePath()
    DECLARE index AS INTEGER
    SET index = 1
    IF split.length < 1 OR NOT split[0].toLowerCase().equals("api") THEN
        THROW IllegalArgumentException("The URI does not start with \"/api\"")
    END IF
    IF split.length < 2 THEN
        DECLARE root AS ARRAY OF STRING
        SET root[0] = ""
        RETURN root
    END IF
    IF split[1].toLowerCase().startsWith("v") AND split[1].length() > 1 AND 
        Character.isDigit(split[1].charAt(1)) THEN
        SET index = 2
    END IF
    IF split.length - index == 0 THEN
        DECLARE root AS ARRAY OF STRING
        SET root[0] = ""
        RETURN root
    END IF
    DECLARE path AS ARRAY OF STRING
    SET path[0] = split[index]
    SET path_idx = 1
    FOR i = index + 1 TO split.length - 1 DO
        SET path[path_idx] = split[i]
        SET path_idx = path_idx + 1
    END FOR
    RETURN path
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION getField(classNode, fieldName)
    WHILE classNode is not NULL DO
        fn = classNode.getDeclaredField(fieldName)
        IF fn is NOT NULL THEN
            RETURN fn
        END IF
        interfaces = classNode.getInterfaces()
        FOR iNode IN interfaces DO
            IF visited contains iNode.getName() THEN
                CONTINUE
            END IF
            ifn = getField(iNode, fieldName)
            visited add iNode.getName()
            IF ifn is NOT NULL THEN
                RETURN ifn
            END IF
        END FOR
        classNode = classNode.getSuperClass()
    END WHILE
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

    IF THIS.TYPE IS INSTANCE OF TYPEVARIABLE THEN

            RETURN TRUE
        END IF
    END IF

END FUNCTION

Subclasses should invoke this method to set the result to {@code value}.

This method will return {@code true} if the value was successfully set, or {@code false} if the data source has already been set, failed or closed.

If the value was successfully set and {@code isLast} is {@code true}, state of the data source will be set to {@link AbstractDataSource.DataSourceStatus#SUCCESS}.

{@link #closeResult} will be called for the previous result if the new value was successfully set, OR for the new result otherwise.

This will also notify the subscribers if the value was successfully set.

Do NOT call this method from a synchronized block as it invokes external code of the subscribers. @param value the value that was the result of the task. @param isLast whether or not the value is last. @return true if the value was successfully set.

FUNCTION setResult(value, isLast)
    SET result = setResultInternal(value, isLast)
    IF result THEN
        CALL notifyDataSubscribers()
    END IF
    RETURN result
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION setResultInternal(value, isLast)
    SET result = FALSE
    IF !isLast THEN
        // The value is not the last one.
        // Return directly.
        RETURN result
    END IF

    // Check if the current status is "closed" or "failed".
    IF getDataSourceStatus() != SUCCESS THEN
        // The data source is closed or failed.
        // Return directly.
        RETURN result
    END IF
    
    // Set the result.
    SET result = TRUE
    SET _result = value
    SET _status = SUCCESS
    RETURN result
END FUNCTION
