FUNCTION transformBinaryConstantExpression(be, targetType)
    wrapperType = getWrapper(targetType)
    IF isTypeOrArrayOfType(targetType, STRING_TYPE, FALSE) AND be.getOperation().getType() EQUALS PLUS THEN
        left = transformInlineConstants(be.getLeftExpression(), targetType)
        right = transformInlineConstants(be.getRightExpression(), targetType)
        IF left instanceof ConstantExpression AND right instanceof ConstantExpression THEN
            RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression((String) ((ConstantExpression) left).getValue() + ((ConstantExpression) right).getValue()))
        END IF
    ELSIF isNumberOrArrayOfNumber(wrapperType, FALSE) AND handledTypes.contains(be.getOperation().getType()) THEN
        leftX = transformInlineConstants(be.getLeftExpression(), targetType)
        rightX = transformInlineConstants(be.getRightExpression(), targetType)
        IF leftX instanceof ConstantExpression AND rightX instanceof ConstantExpression THEN
            left = safeNumber((ConstantExpression) leftX)
            right = safeNumber((ConstantExpression) rightX)
            IF left IS NULL OR right IS NULL THEN
                RETURN NULL
            END IF
            result = NULL
            SWITCH be.getOperation().getType()
                CASE PLUS:
                    result = NumberMath.add(left, right)
                CASE MINUS:
                    result = NumberMath.subtract(left, right)
                CASE MULTIPLY:
                    result = NumberMath.multiply(left, right)
                CASE DIVIDE:
                    result = NumberMath.divide(left, right)
                CASE LEFT_SHIFT:
                    result = NumberMath.leftShift(left, right)
                CASE RIGHT_SHIFT:
                    result = NumberMath.rightShift(left, right)
                CASE RIGHT_SHIFT_UNSIGNED:
                    result = NumberMath.rightShiftUnsigned(left, right)
                CASE BITWISE_AND:
                    result = NumberMath.and(left, right)
                CASE BITWISE_OR:
                    result = NumberMath.or(left, right)
                CASE BITWISE_XOR:
                    result = NumberMath.xor(left, right)
                CASE POWER:
                    result = DefaultGroovyMethods.power(left, right)
            END SWITCH
            IF result IS NOT NULL THEN
                IF ClassHelper.Byte_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.byteValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                IF ClassHelper.Short_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.shortValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                IF ClassHelper.Long_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.longValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                IF ClassHelper.Integer_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) OR ClassHelper.Character_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.intValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                IF ClassHelper.Float_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.floatValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                IF ClassHelper.Double_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN
                    RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result.doubleValue(), TRUE))
                END IF
                RETURN configure(be, new ConstantExpression(result, TRUE))
            END IF
        END IF
    END IF
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION squaredDistance(x, y)
    IF length of x is not equal to length of y THEN
        THROW an IllegalArgumentException
    END IF

    SET sum to 0.0

    FOR each element in x DO
        SET sum to sum + square of difference between current element in x and corresponding element in y
    END FOR

    RETURN sum
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION normalizeSlashes(path)
    SET builder = path
    WHILE length(builder) > 0 AND length(builder) != 1 AND '/' equals last(builder)
        REMOVE last(builder)
        SET modified = True
    END WHILE

    IF length(builder) == 0 OR '/' does not equal first(builder)
        INSERT '/' at index 0
        SET modified = True
    END IF

    IF modified
        RETURN builder
    ELSE
        RETURN path
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION setValueBasedOnAnnotation(key, value)
    matchingMethods ← findMatchingAnnotatedMethods(key)
    FOR method IN matchingMethods
        converterClass ← findAnnotatedTypeConverter(method)
        IF converterClass IS NULL THEN
            CONTINUE
        END IF

        converter ← NEW converterClass
        converter.setObjectMapper(objectMapper)
        convertedValue ← converter.convertQueryParameterToType(value)
        method.invoke(this, convertedValue)
    END FOR
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION findMatchingAnnotatedMethods(key)
    matchingMethods ← []
    FOR method IN this.getClass().getMethods()
        IF NOT method.isAnnotationPresent(CamundaQueryParam.class) THEN
            CONTINUE
        END IF

        annotation ← method.getAnnotation(CamundaQueryParam.class)
        IF NOT annotation.value().equals(key) THEN
            CONTINUE
        END IF

        matchingMethods.add(method)
    END FOR

    RETURN matchingMethods
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION findAnnotatedTypeConverter(method)
    annotations ← method.getDeclaredAnnotationsByType(CamundaQueryParam.class)
    FOR annotation IN annotations
        IF annotation.typeConverter().equals(JacksonAwareStringToTypeConverter.class) THEN
            RETURN annotation.typeConverter()
        END IF
    END FOR

    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

    DECLARE result AS MAP<K, LIST<T>>

        IF NOT key IN result THEN
            result[key] = []

        result[key].append(i)
    END FOR

    RETURN result
END FUNCTION

pseudo_code:
FUNCTION get(size)
    CALL ensurePoolSizeInvariant()
    
    // Get the bucketed size for the requested size
    bucketedSize = CALL getBucketedSize(size)
    sizeInBytes = -1

    LOCK this
        // Try to find an existing value that we can reuse
        bucket = CALL getBucket(bucketedSize)
        IF bucket NOT NULL THEN
            // Find an existing value that we can reuse
            value = CALL getValue(bucket)
            IF value NOT NULL THEN
                // Add the value to the set of used values
                CALL mInUseValues.add(value)
                
                // Update the number of bytes allocated
                bucketedSize = CALL getBucketedSizeForValue(value)
                sizeInBytes = CALL getSizeInBytes(bucketedSize)
                CALL mUsed.increment(sizeInBytes)
                CALL mFree.decrement(sizeInBytes)
                CALL mPoolStatsTracker.onValueReuse(sizeInBytes)
                CALL logStats()
                IF FLog.isLoggable(FLog.VERBOSE) THEN
                    CALL FLog.v(TAG, "get (reuse) (object, size) = (%x, %s)", System.identityHashCode(value), bucketedSize)
                ENDIF
                RETURN value
            END IF
            // Fall through
        END IF
        
        // Check to see if we can allocate a value of the given size without exceeding the hard cap
        sizeInBytes = CALL getSizeInBytes(bucketedSize)
        IF NOT CALL canAllocate(sizeInBytes) THEN
            THROW PoolSizeViolationException(mPoolParams.maxSizeHardCap, mUsed.mNumBytes, mFree.mNumBytes, sizeInBytes)
        END IF

        // Optimistically assume that allocation succeeds - if it fails, we need to undo those changes
        CALL mUsed.increment(sizeInBytes)
        IF bucket NOT NULL THEN
            CALL bucket.incrementInUseCount()
        END IF
    END LOCK

    value = NULL
    TRY
        // Allocate the value outside the synchronized block, because it can be pretty expensive
        // We could have done the allocation inside the synchronized block,
        // but that would have blocked out other operations on the pool
        value = CALL alloc(bucketedSize)
    CATCH e
        // Assumption we made previously is not valid - allocation failed. We need to fix internal
        // counters.
        LOCK this
            CALL mUsed.decrement(sizeInBytes)
            bucket = CALL getBucket(bucketedSize)
            IF bucket NOT NULL THEN
                CALL bucket.decrementInUseCount()
            END IF
        END LOCK
        // Rethrow exception
        CALL Throwables.propagateIfPossible(e)
    END TRY

    // NOTE: We checked for hard caps earlier, and then did the alloc above. Now we need to
    // update state - but it is possible that a concurrent thread did a similar operation - with
    // the result being that we're now over the hard cap.
    // We are willing to live with that situation - especially since the trim call below should
    // be able to trim back memory usage.
    LOCK this
        // Add the value to the set of used values
        CALL mInUseValues.add(value)
        
        // If we're over the pool's max size, try to trim the pool appropriately
        CALL trimToSoftCap()
        CALL mPoolStatsTracker.onAlloc(sizeInBytes)
        CALL logStats()
        IF FLog.isLoggable(FLog.VERBOSE) THEN
            CALL FLog.v(TAG, "get (alloc) (object, size) = (%x, %s)", System.identityHashCode(value), bucketedSize)
        END IF
    END LOCK
    
    RETURN value
END FUNCTION

docstring:
Schedules a new transfer to download data from Amazon S3 using presigned url and save it to the specified file. This method is non-blocking and returns immediately (i.e. before the data has been fully downloaded).

Use the returned {@link PresignedUrlDownload} object to query the progress of the transfer, add listeners for progress events, and wait for the download to complete.

Note: The result of the operation doesn't support pause and resume functionality.

@param request The request containing all the parameters for the download. @param destFile The file to download the object data to. @param downloadContext Additional configuration to control the download behavior @return A new {@link PresignedUrlDownload} object to check the state of the download, listen for progress notifications, and otherwise manage the download.
pseudo_code:
FUNCTION download(request, dest_file, download_context)
    IF request IS NULL OR dest_file IS NULL OR download_context IS NULL THEN
        THROW EXCEPTION
    ENDIF

    APPEND_SINGLE_OBJECT_USER_AGENT(request)
    SET DESCRIPTION TO "Downloading from the given presigned url: " + request.presigned_url()

    SET TRANSFER_PROGRESS TO NEW TransferProgress()
    SET LISTENER_CHAIN TO NEW S3ProgressListenerChain(NEW TransferProgressUpdatingListener(TRANSFER_PROGRESS),
                                                      request.general_progress_listener(),
                                                      download_context.S3progress_listener())

    SET START_BYTE TO 0
    SET END_BYTE TO NULL
    SET RANGE TO request.range()
